items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: Peck Kelly had Peck's bad boys he had Jack T Gordon and Charlie T Gordon

ctx.x: right after lunch and let's see what was the first music you ever heard by the way over there well the

first music that I can really remember was down on West Market in Galveston where my father had a pawn shop he had a pawn shop down at 2509 West Market and just above that they had this colored dance hall and of course back in those days of the old Louie and King Oliver and well those are the two outstanding names as far as I'm concerned with Louie and King Oliver would play for dances over there every Saturday night they had dances and they brought musicians and all over the South but they all came into the…
let me turn it off for just a second well do you remember any of the fellows that were in King Oliver's band or Louis Armstrong's band
